Your Opportunity
We seek talent for our Deal Advisory division at the Executive, Manager, Associate Director, and Director levels.

Transaction Services
KPMG’s Transaction Services team supports clients across a range of industries with strategic and financial due diligence to help clients assess, plan, evaluate and manage acquisitions, mergers, divestments and initial and secondary debt and equity offerings and beyond. This is a multi-disciplinary and international environment that sits right at the heart of our one KPMG ethos.

How are you extraordinary?
Our team are businesspeople first, who thrive on:
•	Solving critical operational and financial challenges and presenting creative and sound commercial opportunities in real time with clients.
•	Building partnerships across diverse client groups with a confidence in creating effective sales material including proposals, case studies, and other sector-specific material.
•	Preserving, adding, or restoring value for clients, stakeholders, and their businesses.
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems.

Your Experience
We are seeking individuals at the Executive to Director level to join our Deal Advisory team, with the below skillsets:
•	Tertiary qualifications in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Law, or other relevant subjects. Ideally with a post-graduate qualification (e.g., CA, CPA, CFA).
•	Recent professional experience in Big 4 / independent corporate advisory, accounting or law firms, investment banking, or within commercial teams in operational businesses.
•	Applicable experiences working across transactions or relevant skills and an interest that will transition into these areas.
•	Strong analytical skills and a commercial flair to generate insights from interpreting data & financial models as well as data analytics.

We are hiring for the following employment types: Casual, Max-Term Full-Time, Max-Term Part-Time, Permanent Full-Time & Permanent Part-Time.

FULL TIME – 2 ROLES OFFERED

ICT Business Analysts and Software Engineer
SALARY Range $75,000 -$110,000 + Super (Annually) 

ICT Business Analysts 
Looking for a software Business Analyst to join software development team.  Someone who is comfortable asking “why?” The ideal candidate is a divergent thinker who understands industry best practices, is team player possessing strong analytical as well as technical skills, and are able to communicate the logic behind technical decisions to non-tech stakeholders.  

Roles and Responsibilities: 
•	Elicits, analyses, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders
•	Collaborates with project s to determine project scope and vision.
•	Identify, investigate, and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices 
•	Identifying and evaluating inefficiencies and recommending optimal business practices, and system functionality and behaviour 
•	Assists in conducting research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
•	Analyses and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
•	Develops templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications
•	Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
•	Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
•	Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
•	Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.

Skills and Qualifications
•	A Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering or Information Technology
•	2+ years’ software development or programming experience 
•	Able to exercise independent judgment and take action on it
•	Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
•	Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
•	Logical and efficient, with keen attention to detail

Expected Salary
•	$75,000 – $100,000 +Super (Annually) 


SOFTWARE ENGINEER
Looking for a passionate Software Engineer to design, develop and install software solutions. Software Engineer responsibilities include gathering user requirements, defining system functionality and writing code in various languages, like Java, or .NET programming languages (e.g. C++ or JScript.NET.)  

Roles and Responsibilities: 
•	Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements and solutions
•	Document and demonstrate the solutions by developing documentation, code comments and clear code
•	Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC)
•	Design algorithms and data structures
•	Write well-designed, testable code with the comments
•	Produce specifications and determine operational feasibility
•	Integrate software components into a fully functional software system
•	Develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
•	Document and maintain software functionality
•	Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems
•	Deploy programs and evaluate user feedback
•	Strong analytical and reasoning skills with an ability to visualise processes and outcomes
•	Troubleshoot software issues and debug large codebase
•	Liaising with colleagues to implement technical designs
•	Investigating and using new technologies where relevant
•	Comply with project plans and industry standards
•	Enhancing applications by	identifying opportunities	for improvement,	 making recommendations and designing and implementing systems
•	Maintaining and improving existing codebases and peer review code changes
•	Providing written knowledge transfer material
•	Ensure software is updated with latest features.
•	Improve system quality by identifying issues and common patterns, and developing standard operating procedures

Skills and Qualifications
•	Relevant Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or equivalent 
•	Minimum 3+ years in Software Engineering/Development
•	Specialisation of SDLC execution and designing algorithms and data structures 
•	Agile project experience
•	Consulting organisation experience
•	Skilled ability to work in a dynamic team, contributing to the overall goals of the group 
•	Skilled ability to perform synthesis and analysis working at the conceptual level

Expected Salary
•	$80,000 - $110,000 + Super (Annually)

•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Overview:

The ICT Change and Configuration Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing the development, delivery and evaluation of critical change management programs, projects and services that minimise the risk of changes to the Departments information systems, services and infrastructure.

The role formulates strategies, frameworks, policies, and practices which drive change and configuration management across a complex, hybrid on premise and cloud environment and guides a high performing team in the delivery of critical and complex change and configuration management related functions and services.

The ICT Change and Configuration Manager provides high level advice to, and negotiates with, executive and senior staff across the Department in relation to complex and strategic issues and risks, and engages with internal and external project managers, service providers and vendors to influence, facilitate and drive best practice change management.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 944922

Criminal History Screening Requirement

A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment).

Immunisation Risk for this position is Category C (minimal patient contact).

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.
